$comment: LSP wiring for the WSL/Linux checkout (the agent-automation host). Windows VS Code: override clangd.path in user settings to tools/llvm-mingw/bin/clangd.exe and python.defaultInterpreterPath to .venv\Scripts\python.exe. Memory tuning: this host class has ~13 GB RAM, so clangd indexes in the background with 4 workers and trims its heap; the codec is ~12 translation units, so the index stays small.
